contentEn: Aatrox's Q skill deals bonus damage and knocks up enemies hit by the edge. It's crucial to use your E skill to either dash inside Aatrox's Q range or dodge to the side.

Aatrox maximizes his healing by adjusting his position with E while casting Q. Renekton's empowered W (Ruthless Predator) has a shield break effect, allowing you to nullify Aatrox's healing and gain an advantage in trades.
Renekton is strong early while Akali is weak. Use Q and W for aggressive trades in levels 1-3 to pressure Akali's health and gain lane priority.
When Akali uses W (Twilight Shroud), activate R (Dominus) for bonus health and area-of-effect magic damage. This makes it easier to chase Akali within her shroud and set up a lethal kill window.

titleEn: Counter Ambessa's Shield with Empowered W
contentEn: Ambessa's W (Shield of Repulsion) provides a powerful shield. Use Renekton's Empowered W (Ruthless Predator) to break her shield and neutralize Ambessa's tanking ability.

titleEn: Utilize Early Game Priority and Pressure
contentEn: Renekton is a hard counter to Ambessa. Engage in aggressive trades and apply pressure from the early game to seize lane priority and prevent Ambessa from scaling.

Aurora's E skill has excellent dash judgment and a slow effect, allowing it to counter Renekton's dash. Engage after Aurora uses her E skill, or initiate a trade once you confirm her E skill is on cooldown.

titleEn: Countering Aurora's Passive with Empowered W
contentEn: Aurora's passive generates a healing spirit on every third hit. Renekton's empowered W has a shield break effect, so destroy the spirit generated by Aurora's passive to weaken her sustain.
Camille's Passive shield is crucial for trades, so accumulate 50 Fury and use Empowered W (Ruthless Predator) to break her shield and unleash burst damage.
Before core items are completed, Renekton has superior base stats compared to Camille. Aggressively trade in the 1-3 level range to gain lane priority and apply pressure.

When Darius uses Q (Decimate), use E (Slice and Dice) to dash inside, avoiding the axe blade damage. Then, use W (Ruthless Predator) for a stun, follow up with Q (Cull the Meek) for a trade, and use E to disengage, preventing Darius from stacking 5 Hemorrhage stacks.

titleEn: Fury Management and Empowered W Usage
contentEn: If Darius pulls you with E (Apprehend) and you have 50 or more Fury, immediately stun him with Empowered W (Ruthless Predator) to interrupt his trade and deal damage in return.

titleEn: Neutralize Mundo's Passive with Empowered W
contentEn: Dr. Mundo's passive ignores immobilizing effects, but Renekton's empowered W (Ruthless Predator) has a shield-breaking effect that can remove Mundo's passive shield. Use your empowered W when Mundo's passive is on cooldown to gain an advantage in trades.

titleEn: Pressure Mundo's Sustain with Your Ultimate
contentEn: Dr. Mundo recovers a tremendous amount of health with his ultimate (R). Renekton's ultimate (R) grants bonus health and Fury, increasing his combat sustain. When Mundo uses his ultimate, activate Renekton's ultimate to counter and continuously pressure Mundo's sustain.

titleEn: Gain the Psychological Edge with Riposte (W)
contentEn: Fiora's Riposte (W) can block Renekton's Ruthless Predator (W), but Renekton has the psychological advantage. Make it difficult for Fiora to bait out Riposte by only using E-Q followed by an auto-attack, or by faking with E-Q-auto-W.

titleEn: Solidify Your Stat Advantage with Dominus (R) at Level 6
contentEn: After Level 6, using Dominus (R) significantly increases Renekton's stats, making it difficult for Fiora to keep up. Utilize your ultimate to gain an overwhelming advantage in trades and look for solo kill opportunities.
Gangplank's W (Remove Scurvy) removes Renekton's W (Ruthless Predator) stun. Confirm Gangplank has used his W before using Renekton's W to ensure the stun effect lands.
Gangplank has strong long-range poke with his Q (Parrrley) and E (Powder Keg). Quickly destroy the Powder Kegs or attempt trades outside of their range to minimize damage.
Garen's Courage (W) has a long cooldown. After Garen uses his W, you can gain an advantage in trades, so actively seek trades with empowered Q or W when his W is on cooldown.

Renekton has strong early game trades. He has an advantage over Garen until his first item, so manage your Fury well to continuously pressure Garen's health with empowered abilities and look for lethal setups.

When Gnar is Mini Gnar, using E (Hop) allows for a double jump, which can be used to close gaps or escape. If Gnar uses E just before transforming into Mega Gnar, it becomes a double-jumped Crunch, making surprise engagements crucial.
Keep an eye on Gnar's fury bar. Avoid trading just before he transforms into Mega Gnar, and actively seek trades when he is in Mini Gnar form to prevent him from transforming at his desired timing.

titleEn: Gragas E Skill Bait and Dodge
contentEn: Gragas's Body Slam (E) can interrupt Renekton's Slice and Dice (E). Bait Gragas into using his E, then use your E to dodge or engage.

titleEn: Neutralize Gragas W Damage Reduction with Empowered W
contentEn: When Gragas activates damage reduction with Drunken Rage (W), use Renekton's empowered W (Ruthless Predator) to break his shield and neutralize Gragas's damage reduction, then burst him down.

Gwen's W (Hallowed Mist) ignores targeting from enemies outside its area. If Gwen uses W, use E (Skip 'n Slash) to move out of the mist and either wait for your skill cooldowns or target another enemy.
Gwen struggles with Renekton's hit-and-run trades at levels 1-2. After level 3, utilize all your Q-W-E skills to build up Fury for an empowered W, then attempt a powerful trade.
Heimerdinger's turrets can be easily removed with Renekton's Q. Weaken Heimerdinger's damage by removing his turrets first, then use E to engage and trade damage.

Heimerdinger is vulnerable to Renekton's W due to his lack of mobility. After engaging with E, use Empowered W to stun Heimerdinger, interrupting his turret placement and ability usage, then burst him down.

titleEn: Dodging and Countering Illaoi's E Skill
contentEn: Illaoi's Test of Spirit (E) is her core skill, so it's crucial to dodge it. If you are hit by her E, quickly destroy the spirit while avoiding Illaoi's tentacle attacks, or engage Illaoi directly to trade damage.

Renekton's W (Ruthless Predator) is an excellent tool to interrupt Illaoi's tentacle attacks or initiate one-sided trades against her. Empowered W, in particular, can counter Illaoi's healing with its shield break effect.
Irelia's Defiant Dance (W) reduces the damage from Renekton's Ruthless Predator (W). To maximize your damage, use Renekton's W after Irelia has used her W.
Irelia has an advantage against Renekton before he has all his skills at Level 3. Avoid trading before Level 3 and focus on building up your Fury.
Jarvan's Q-E combo is a powerful airborne CC. When you see Jarvan throw his flag, use your E ability to dodge or your W ability to stun him and interrupt the combo.

titleEn: Breaking Jarvan's Shield with Empowered W
contentEn: Jarvan gains a shield from his W ability. Use Renekton's empowered W (Ruthless Predator) to break Jarvan's shield and gain an advantage in trades.

Jax's E (Counter Strike) ignores basic attacks, so if Jax uses E, save your W (Ruthless Predator) and trade damage with Q (Cull the Meek) or E (Slice and Dice) before disengaging. Once Jax's E ends, stun him with W and deal damage.

After Level 3, Renekton gains an advantage over Jax once all his skills are learned. Utilize the long range of E (Slice and Dice) to initiate trades outside of Jax's E range, and quickly disengage if Jax uses E.
When Jayce approaches in Hammer Form, stun him with an empowered W (50+ Fury) to initiate a trade. This will interrupt Jayce's burst damage and give you an advantage.
Jayce's empowered Q (QE combo) is very strong. Use your E to dodge it or close the gap for a trade as soon as Jayce fires his Q.
K'Sante's W can block Renekton's W combo. If K'Sante uses W, wait a moment before using your skills, or use E to disengage and avoid the trade.
K'Sante is stronger than Renekton in the early game. Even after level 3, K'Sante's W can block Renekton's combos, so avoid aggressive trades in the early laning phase and focus on stable scaling.

Kayle is weak in the early game, so actively seek trades from Level 1 to build up your Fury. Use your Q skill to restore health and seize lane priority. Harass Kayle to prevent her from stacking her Zeal.
Once Kayle transforms into a ranged champion at Level 6, quickly close the gap with E-E, then stun her with an empowered W and burst her down. It's crucial to bait out Kayle's W healing skill.
Kennen's E is his only escape and engage tool. Try to bait it out before attempting a trade. A Kennen without E is vulnerable to Renekton's dash.

titleEn: Interrupting Kennen's Stun with Empowered W
contentEn: Kennen applies marks with his abilities to stun. Use Renekton's empowered W (Ruthless Predator)'s 1.5-second stun to interrupt Kennen's ability combos or ultimate engage.

Kled's Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) applies a healing reduction effect. Use the second dash of your E (Violent Tendencies) to dodge the second hit of the trap or create distance to avoid the healing reduction.
When Kled is dismounted, it's Renekton's kill window. Use the stun and shield-breaking effect of your empowered W (Ruthless Predator) to interrupt Kled's courage recovery and quickly take him down.

Malphite has low early-game armor and high mana costs on his Q, making him vulnerable to poke. At levels 1-3, build up Fury to initiate trades with empowered W, then quickly engage with E for a trade and disengage.
Renekton's empowered W can break Malphite's passive shield. When trading, use empowered W to neutralize his shield and deal additional damage.
Before level 6, Renekton has an advantage against Mordekaiser. Use your Fury-empowered Q and W to aggressively trade damage, gain a health lead, and secure lane priority.

After Mordekaiser learns his ultimate at level 6, diving him becomes difficult. Maximize your advantage before level 6, and afterward, keep track of Mordekaiser's ultimate (R) cooldown to set up ganks or dives.
Nasus is weak in the early game, so actively harass him to prevent him from stacking Q at levels 1-3. Use empowered W for strong trades to pressure his HP and gain lane priority.
Nasus tends to pull the lane, so coordinate with your jungler to set up dives. This will hinder Nasus's growth and allow you to snowball the game to a quick finish.

Olaf's ultimate (R) grants him CC immunity and increased combat power, rendering Renekton's W (stun) ineffective when Olaf uses his ultimate. Try to engage in trades with W when Olaf's ultimate is on cooldown.

Olaf frequently attempts sustained trades with his Q (Undertow) and E (Reckless Swing). Renekton should utilize the healing effect of his empowered Q (Cull the Meek) to enhance his lane sustain and withstand Olaf's poke.

Ornn's W (Bellows Breath) grants him Unstoppable status. If Renekton uses W (Ruthless Predator) to stun Ornn while he is casting W, it can be nullified. It is better to apply the stun after Ornn's W ends.
Ornn is strong in burst trades and can ignore Renekton's CC with his W ability. Since Renekton's strength in short trades is ineffective, you should avoid prolonged fights and hit-and-run tactics.

Pantheon's E skill grants invulnerability from the front, but he cannot move while casting it. When Pantheon uses E, wait for a moment and then use your W (stun) as the skill ends to initiate a trade.

Pantheon's power significantly increases after level 6 with his ultimate, so you should aim for kills or a CS lead before then. Actively seek trades with a full-stack W (empowered stun) and Q (empowered heal) combo.
Poppy's W (Steadfast Presence) blocks Renekton's E (Slice and Dice) dash and stuns him. Therefore, attempt a trade with E after confirming Poppy has used her W or when it's on cooldown.

Poppy is strong in sustained trades, and her shield and max health damage put Renekton at a disadvantage. Use a hit-and-run strategy: quickly deal damage with an E-W-Q combo and disengage with the second cast of E.
Quinn's E (Vault) can interrupt Renekton's E (Slice and Dice). Try to bait out Quinn's E, or save your E to dodge her Vault before engaging for a trade.
Quinn can easily counter Renekton's engage, but during an allied jungler's gank, you can use Flash W (Ruthless Predator) to stun her, neutralizing her E and creating a kill window.

titleEn: Counter Riven's Shield with Empowered W
contentEn: When Riven uses her E to generate a shield, use your W with 50 or more Fury to break her shield and deal significant damage and stun. This neutralizes Riven's core survival and trade tool.

titleEn: Gain Sustained Combat Advantage with Ultimate
contentEn: When Riven attempts to trade with her ultimate active, use Renekton's ultimate (R) to gain bonus health and Fury, and deal sustained damage. Renekton gains a significant advantage in sustained combat over Riven while his ultimate is active.
Rumble possesses strong dueling capabilities even at levels 1-2. During this phase, try to avoid trades as much as possible and focus on farming CS to prevent falling behind.
Rumble's W ability provides a shield. It's crucial to use Renekton's empowered W (Ruthless Predator) to break Rumble's shield and gain an advantage in trades.
Since Renekton lacks early mobility and has weak trades, actively seek trades with his double dash using Q and E at levels 1-3 to apply pressure.
Renekton has no shield, so accumulate 50 Fury and use Empowered W (Ruthless Predator) for a powerful stun and damage to create one-sided trades.

titleEn: Counter Sett's W with Empowered W
contentEn: When Sett attempts to use his W (Haymaker), use Renekton's empowered W (Ruthless Predator) to break his shield and gain an advantage in trades.
To avoid Sett's Q (Knuckle Down) movement speed approach or his E (Facebreaker), use Renekton's E (Slice and Dice) to safely trade damage and disengage.

titleEn: Bait Shen's W and then use your W
contentEn: Shen's Spirit's Refuge (W) nullifies Renekton's Ruthless Predator (W). If Shen uses his W, wait a moment for the ability to end before using Renekton's W.
Renekton has superior lane pushing power compared to Shen. Quickly push the lane to keep Shen tied to his turret, then look for small skirmishes to gain an advantage.

titleEn: Counter Singed's Trades with Empowered W
contentEn: When Singed approaches with his Q activated, stun him with Empowered W and initiate a trade. Even with his Q on, Singed will struggle to deal damage during the stun duration.
When Singed activates his Q to escape or approach, use the second dash of your E ability to dodge his poison trail or close the gap to initiate a trade.
Sion's Q (Decimating Smash) has a long wind-up and is very powerful. When Sion charges his Q, interrupt him with Renekton's W (Ruthless Predator) stun to gain a trade advantage.
Sion's W (Soul Furnace) shield can be destroyed by Renekton's empowered W (Ruthless Predator). When Sion uses his W, accumulate 50 Fury to use empowered W to neutralize his shield and deal damage.
Sylas has weak early game stats and poor wave clear. Utilize Q and W for trades in levels 1-3 to gain a health advantage and create a CS lead.

Sylas's W provides good sustain with its missing health-based healing. Use Renekton's Empowered W (three attacks, shield break, 1.5-second stun) to nullify Sylas's healing and gain an advantage in trades.
Teemo's Q (Blinding Dart) nullifies Renekton's W (Ruthless Predator). Confirm Teemo has used his Q, or wait for it to be on cooldown, then use your W to gain an advantage in trades.

titleEn: Utilize E for Trades and Disengages
contentEn: Teemo lacks mobility, so use Renekton's E (Slice and Dice)'s two dashes to quickly engage, trade damage, and disengage using a hit-and-run strategy. Utilizing minions makes this even more effective.

After Level 3, Renekton has the first strike advantage. When Trundle's W (Frozen Domain) is on cooldown or unavailable, use your E-W-Q combo for a quick trade and disengage to avoid Trundle's sustained combat.

When Trundle uses his ultimate (R), he steals your Armor and Magic Resist. Utilize the bonus Health and Fury from Renekton's ultimate (R) to sustain through it, or use your E ability to quickly create distance and outlast Trundle's ultimate duration.
Tryndamere is vulnerable to critical strike RNG before Level 3. It's crucial to avoid trades until Level 3 and sustain through the lane with your Q ability.

titleEn: Counter Tryndamere's Ultimate with Empowered W
contentEn: When Tryndamere uses his ultimate, disable him with your Empowered W (three attacks, shield break, 1.5-second stun) and deal as much damage as possible during his ultimate's duration.

titleEn: Disrupt Twisted Fate's Gold Card Usage
contentEn: Twisted Fate attempts to trade by drawing a Gold Card to stun you. When Twisted Fate begins his card draw animation, quickly approach with your E ability to stun him with an empowered W, or initiate a trade with your Q ability to disrupt his trade and gain an advantage.

Twisted Fate exerts influence on other lanes by roaming with his ultimate. When Twisted Fate uses his ultimate, immediately use your R ability to gain Rage, then quickly approach with your E ability to stop his roam, or request backup from allies to take down Twisted Fate.
Urgot's Level 1 trade potential is very strong, so avoid trading at Level 1. Instead, focus on clearing minions with your Q skill and building up your Fury.

titleEn: Pressuring and Seeking Kills Before Level 9
contentEn: Urgot's power spike begins at Level 9. Before then, use strong trades with your E-W combo to pressure the enemy and look for kill windows to widen your lead.

titleEn: Gain Psychological Advantage with Vladimir's W
contentEn: Vladimir's Sanguine Pool (W) can dodge Renekton's Ruthless Predator (W). When Vladimir uses Sanguine Pool, Renekton can either wait for the pool to end and then use W again, or bait out the pool and then attempt a trade with other abilities to gain a psychological advantage.

titleEn: Pressure with Strong Early Game Trades
contentEn: Renekton possesses strong early game trading potential. In the early game, when Vladimir's Q skill has a long cooldown, utilize the E-W-Q combo to deal significant damage. If Vladimir uses Sanguine Pool (W), disengage, wait for the cooldown, and then re-engage to assert lane dominance.

titleEn: Counter Volibear's W Heal with Empowered W
contentEn: Volibear heals upon reactivating his W after marking a target. Utilize Renekton's Empowered W (Ruthless Predator)'s shield break effect to nullify Volibear's W heal and gain an advantage in trades.

Volibear becomes stronger after using his W twice. Renekton should repeatedly engage in short trades, using the E-W-Q combo for quick damage and then disengaging with E to prevent Volibear from reactivating his W.

titleEn: Be Mindful of Warwick's Q Skill Usage
contentEn: Warwick's Q grants Unstoppable, allowing him to ignore Renekton's W stun. Either use your W after Warwick uses his Q, or confirm that Warwick's Q is on cooldown before using your W.

titleEn: Counter Warwick's Healing with Empowered W
contentEn: Warwick has excellent healing capabilities through his Passive and Q skill. Renekton's Empowered W has a shield break effect, so use it to nullify Warwick's healing.

titleEn: Don't Waste Skills on Wukong's Clone
contentEn: Wukong's W (Clone) can bait out Renekton's skills, causing you to waste cooldowns. Be careful not to use W (Stun) or empowered Q on the clone. Instead, use your skills on the real Wukong after the clone disappears.

Renekton gains an advantage over Wukong starting at Level 3. After accumulating 50 or more Fury, initiate a trade with the E-W-Empowered Q-E combo. If Wukong escapes, use Q to restore health and maintain lane sustain.

titleEn: Disable Yasuo's Shield with Empowered W
contentEn: Yasuo's passive shield and Immortal Shieldbow's shield are disabled by Renekton's Empowered W (Ruthless Predator). When trading with Yasuo, accumulate 50 Fury to use Empowered W to break his shield and initiate a one-sided trade.
While Yasuo may have an advantage before Level 3, Renekton gains strong trading power after Level 3. From Level 3 onwards, actively seek trades to seize lane priority and pressure Yasuo.

titleEn: Neutralize Yone's Shield with Empowered W
contentEn: Yone's W ability creates a shield. Accumulate 50 Fury and use your Empowered W (Ruthless Predator) to break Yone's shield and gain an advantage in trades.

Yone's E (Soul Unbound) makes him unstoppable upon recall, but Renekton's E (Slice and Dice) allows for a two-part dash. When Yone engages with E, break his shield with Empowered W, trade damage, then use E to disengage and avoid Yone's return damage.
Yorick's W is easily destroyed by Renekton's E (Slice and Dice). When Yorick uses W, immediately use E to dash in, disable it, and initiate a trade.

Yorick's ultimate has a long cooldown, while Renekton's ultimate provides bonus health, allowing him to withstand attacks from Yorick's ghouls and Maiden of the Mist. If Yorick uses his ultimate, avoid trading and capitalize on your cooldown advantage.
Zac is weak in the early game. Utilize your Q and W to aggressively trade damage between levels 1-3, and step on Zac's blobs to prevent his health regeneration.
Zac is strong at tower diving, so you might be counter-killed by his Q-E-R CC combo during a dive. Check Zac's skill cooldowns and attempt dives cautiously.

titleEn: Stun Zed with W during his ultimate
contentEn: When Zed uses his ultimate, he is guaranteed to dash to Renekton. Use W (Ruthless Predator) the moment Zed casts his ultimate to stun him and prevent his damage.

titleEn: Counter Zed's assassination attempt with Dominus (R)
contentEn: Before Zed's ultimate mark detonates, activate Dominus (R) to gain bonus health and Fury. This allows you to withstand Zed's burst damage and counter-engage.
